name: Mani Karthik Bollimuntha
title: Senior Appian Developer
tagline: 7+ years building scalable Appian applications, now with Appian AI, for federal, banking, and pharma clients. Appian Level 2 Certified, with light full-stack and Flutter on the side.
about: I architect and deliver enterprise-grade Appian applications across the core platform: SAIL, Appian AI, process models, expression rules, records, CDTs, and Connected Systems integrations, backed by MySQL and SQL Server work that I tune myself.

Since 2023 I have been on a federal compliance and funding platform for USAC, where I drive performance tuning, establish design patterns, lead code reviews, and mentor junior developers. Before that: loan onboarding for HSBC and a scheduling and audit platform for IQVIA.
React, Java, and Flutter are my complementary tools: I use them for side projects and integrations, including a visa-guide app with over a thousand installs and an Appian interview-practice site.

experience.client: USAC (Universal Service Administrative Co.), federal compliance and funding platform
bullets: Design and build performant Appian applications for complex federal compliance cases, keeping the Funding Form workflows fast and easy to use.
Work across the full lifecycle with SAIL, process models, expression rules, records, and CDTs, from database design to user experience.
Optimize MySQL stored procedures and data models for multi-table validation, retrieval, and inserts.
Contribute to performance analysis and system tuning, finding and fixing bottlenecks in process execution and SAIL load times.
Built reusable REST integrations through Appian Connected Systems against USAC's internal validation APIs.
Break down stories, define acceptance criteria, and support technical feature design each sprint.
Review peers' code and set the team's review standard for SAIL practices, CDT reuse, and security roles.
Troubleshoot emergent issues, ship bug fixes, and deploy features to higher environments.
Use Appian AI Document Classification and Document Extraction to process compliance forms, improving extraction accuracy and processing speed.
Plan new applications and speed up technical feature design with Appian AI Composer.
Generate test cases for critical expression rules with Appian AI, raising coverage and rule reliability.
Mentor two junior Appian developers on platform standards and review practices.
experience.award: Conducted technical interviews and refined the evaluation standards that help scale the iLabs engineering team.

experience.client: HSBC, client loan onboarding and risk assessment
experience.stack: Appian 20 to 21, REST APIs, AI integration
bullets: Built and demoed the proof of concept for the loan onboarding application to HSBC stakeholders, which helped secure the engagement.
Designed a reusable risk-assessment application on process models with conditional branching that tiers applicants into low, medium, or high risk.
Integrated AI APIs into Appian through REST Connected Systems.
Troubleshot application issues and managed deployments across Dev, SFT, and Pre-Prod, coordinating with several teams.
Cut query time on the onboarding modules by about 25% through index optimization and removing redundant calls in expression rules.

experience.client: IQVIA, meeting scheduler and audit log platform
experience.stack: Appian 18 to 20, SQL Server, REST / SOAP
bullets: Designed and built a meeting scheduler with a task scheduler and an audit log module across GDMPM projects.
Built process models with parallel approval gateways and conditional paths that automated scheduling, conflict detection, and participant notifications.
Wrote SAIL expression rules for date and time conflict resolution, and admin interfaces with role-based access and conditional rendering.
Created SQL Server triggers and stored procedures for a compliance-grade audit trail.
Ran regular demos with business analysts to validate requirements and refine features.
experience.award: Company award for an AI chat integration inside Appian, and first place in Hexaware's full-stack development training.

bullets: Designed and built Java web applications in an Agile team, using object-oriented design to keep them maintainable.
Developed RESTful and SOAP web services, wrote optimized MySQL queries, and covered the code with JUnit tests.
Added price sorting and third-party payment gateway integration to an e-commerce mobile app.
Proposed new app concepts and helped the core team build them.

projects.name: Visa Sage
projects.description: A Flutter guide to US F1 visa requirements and procedures, with an AI mock visa interview. Firebase handles auth and live updates. Over a thousand installs and still maintained.

projects.name: Appian Verse
projects.description: Full-stack practice site for Appian interviews: React front end, Supabase backend, Vercel hosting, Cloudflare for domain and security. Its AI mock interviewer runs on RAG over vector search in Supabase, with Claude asking the questions.

projects.name: Coinly
projects.description: A private Flutter expense and budget tracker. Log income, expenses and transfers across accounts, set monthly category budgets, and read clear reports. Data stays on the device, no account required.

projects.name: Dotkin
